_comment: Hand-curated media generation prompts. Merged over the generated set by build_media_prompts.py (flagged is_curated). Style-agnostic: the global style block is prepended at generation time.

image.camera: side-on camera, full body in frame, wide enough to show floor and air space above her head
image.pose_a: full-body action photo of the athlete mid-burpee, frozen at the bottom of the push-up phase: body in a rigid straight line just above the floor, chest hovering a few centimetres off the ground, hands planted under her shoulders, toes tucked, neck neutral, eyes down
image.pose_b: full-body action photo of the athlete at the peak of the burpee jump: fully airborne 30 cm off the floor, body stretched tall, arms reaching straight overhead with fingers extended, toes pointed, slight motion energy in her hair

video.camera: locked-off side-on camera, full body always in frame with headroom for the jump, no cuts, no camera movement
video.summary: 8-second seamless loop: exactly two full burpee reps at a steady athletic pace, one rep every 4 seconds, ending in the identical standing position the clip starts in

beats.0: She stands tall, feet shoulder-width apart, then crouches and plants both hands on the floor just inside her feet.
beats.1: She jumps her feet back into a high plank and lowers her chest to the floor in one fluid push-up descent.
beats.2: She presses powerfully back up to plank and snaps her feet forward to land just behind her hands.
beats.3: She explodes upward into a vertical jump, arms sweeping straight overhead, then lands softly with bent knees back into standing.
beats.4: Without pausing she crouches again and plants both hands on the floor, beginning the second identical rep.
beats.5: Feet jump back to plank; chest lowers to the floor in the same smooth push-up.
beats.6: She presses up and snaps her feet forward to her hands, loading the legs.
beats.7: She jumps vertically with arms overhead and lands softly, finishing standing tall in exactly the same pose and position as frame one so the clip loops seamlessly.

image.camera: straight-on front camera, full body in frame, symmetrical composition
image.pose_a: full-body action photo of the athlete frozen at the open star position of a jumping jack: fully airborne a few centimetres off the floor, feet wider than shoulders, both arms swept up at 45 degrees above her head forming an X shape, energetic expression
image.pose_b: full-body action photo of the athlete frozen at the closed position of a jumping jack: feet together just leaving the floor, arms slapping down to her sides, body tall and compact, mid-bounce

video.camera: locked-off straight-on front camera, full body in frame, perfectly centred, no cuts, no camera movement
video.summary: 8-second seamless loop: exactly four full jumping jacks at a bright steady rhythm, one rep every 2 seconds, starting and ending feet-together with arms at her sides

beats.0: From standing with feet together and arms at her sides, she jumps her feet out wide while her arms sweep overhead into a star shape.
beats.1: She jumps her feet back together as her arms swing back down to her sides, landing lightly on the balls of her feet.
beats.2: Second rep: feet jump out wide, arms sweep overhead, light and rhythmic.
beats.3: Feet snap back together, arms return to her sides, posture tall.
beats.4: Third rep: out wide with arms overhead, hair and body showing gentle bounce energy.
beats.5: Back together, arms to sides, steady breathing rhythm.
beats.6: Fourth rep: feet out wide, arms sweeping fully overhead one last time.
beats.7: She lands back with feet together and arms at her sides in exactly the same pose as frame one so the clip loops seamlessly.

image.camera: side-on camera, full body in frame, kettlebell path fully visible
image.pose_a: full-body action photo of the athlete frozen at the top of a kettlebell swing: standing tall in a hard hip lockout, glutes squeezed, both hands gripping a single dark cast-iron kettlebell floating at chest height with arms straight, body forming a vertical line
image.pose_b: full-body action photo of the athlete frozen at the bottom of a kettlebell swing: hips hinged deep with a flat back, the kettlebell swung back between and slightly behind her legs, shins vertical, eyes forward, loaded like a spring

video.camera: locked-off side-on camera, full body and the entire arc of the kettlebell always in frame, no cuts, no camera movement
video.summary: 8-second seamless loop: exactly four powerful kettlebell swings, one rep every 2 seconds, hips driving the bell to chest height each time, starting and ending at the same mid-swing hinge point

beats.0: From a deep hip hinge with the kettlebell swung back between her legs, she snaps her hips forward and the bell floats up to chest height with straight arms.
beats.1: The bell falls back along the same arc as she hinges at the hips, flat back, the bell passing back between her legs.
beats.2: Second swing: explosive hip snap, glutes squeeze, the bell rises smoothly to chest height.
beats.3: Controlled descent back into the hinge, arms relaxed, all the work in the hips.
beats.4: Third swing up to chest height, body reaching a strong vertical plank-like lockout at the top.
beats.5: The bell swings back down and through her legs, breathing sharp and rhythmic.
beats.6: Fourth swing: hips fire, the bell floats to chest height one final time.
beats.7: The bell descends back into the exact deep hinge position of frame one so the clip loops seamlessly.

image.camera: three-quarter front camera, full body in frame with headroom above her extended arms
image.pose_a: full-body action photo of the athlete frozen at the bottom of a dumbbell thruster: in a deep squat with thighs below parallel, a dumbbell racked on each shoulder, elbows lifted, chest proud, heels planted
image.pose_b: full-body action photo of the athlete frozen at the lockout of a dumbbell thruster: standing fully extended, both dumbbells pressed directly overhead with arms locked and biceps by her ears, body in one strong vertical line

video.camera: locked-off three-quarter front camera, full body in frame with headroom for the overhead press, no cuts, no camera movement
video.summary: 8-second seamless loop: exactly two smooth dumbbell thrusters, one rep every 4 seconds, squat flowing directly into the overhead press in one continuous motion

beats.0: Standing with a dumbbell racked on each shoulder, she begins descending into a squat, hips back, chest tall.
beats.1: She reaches full squat depth, thighs below parallel, elbows high, dumbbells steady on her shoulders.
beats.2: She drives up explosively, the momentum flowing straight into the press as the dumbbells leave her shoulders.
beats.3: Full lockout: arms extended overhead, body tall, then the dumbbells lower back under control to her shoulders.
beats.4: Second rep begins: she descends into the squat with the same smooth tempo.
beats.5: Bottom of the squat, depth below parallel, chest proud, core braced.
beats.6: Explosive drive upward, dumbbells pressing overhead to a strong lockout.
beats.7: The dumbbells lower back to her shoulders as she settles into exactly the same standing rack position as frame one so the clip loops seamlessly.

image.camera: low side-on camera at floor level, full body in frame
image.pose_a: full-body action photo of the athlete frozen at the bottom of a push-up: body in a rigid straight line from head to heels, chest one fist's height off the floor, elbows bent at 45 degrees from her torso, core braced, neck neutral
image.pose_b: full-body action photo of the athlete frozen at the top of a push-up: arms fully locked out in a high plank, body in one perfect straight line from shoulders to heels, shoulder blades protracted, gaze down at the floor

video.camera: locked-off low side-on camera at floor level, full body in frame, no cuts, no camera movement
video.summary: 8-second seamless loop: exactly two strict push-ups at a controlled tempo, 2 seconds down and 2 seconds up, body rigid as a plank throughout, starting and ending at the top position

beats.0: From a high plank with hands under shoulders, she begins lowering, elbows tracking at 45 degrees, body one straight line.
beats.1: She reaches the bottom, chest hovering just above the floor, everything tight and controlled.
beats.2: She presses the floor away, rising steadily, hips and shoulders moving as one unit.
beats.3: Full lockout at the top of the high plank, body straight, a brief composed pause.
beats.4: Second rep: she lowers again with the same controlled two-second descent.
beats.5: Bottom position, chest just off the floor, elbows tucked, core rigid.
beats.6: Smooth powerful press back up, body perfectly aligned.
beats.7: She arrives at the exact top-of-plank position of frame one, settled and still, so the clip loops seamlessly.

image.camera: three-quarter rear camera so her back, the overhead pulley and the wide bar are all clearly visible, full body and machine in frame
image.pose_a: full-body photo of the athlete seated at a black steel lat pulldown cable machine with a high pulley, padded seat and thigh pads: arms fully extended overhead gripping a long straight wide-grip bar, torso upright with a slight backward lean, lats stretched, thighs secured under the pads
image.pose_b: full-body photo of the athlete seated at a black steel lat pulldown cable machine, frozen at the bottom of the pull: the wide bar drawn down to her upper chest, elbows driven down and back, shoulder blades squeezed together, lats flared and visibly engaged, chest lifted, cable taut from the high pulley

video.camera: locked-off three-quarter rear camera, her full body, the seat, the high pulley and the entire travel of the bar always in frame, no cuts, no camera movement
video.summary: 8-second seamless loop: exactly four wide-grip lat pulldown reps, one rep every 2 seconds — one second pulling the bar down to the upper chest, one second controlling it back to full stretch — starting and ending with arms fully extended overhead

beats.0: Seated with thighs under the pads and arms fully extended overhead gripping the wide bar, she pulls the bar smoothly down to her upper chest, elbows driving down and back, shoulder blades squeezing.
beats.1: She controls the bar back up along the same path until her arms reach full overhead stretch, cable staying taut.
beats.2: Second rep: the bar travels down to her collarbone, chest lifted, slight backward lean, lats flaring.
beats.3: Controlled return to the full overhead stretch, torso steady, no swinging.
beats.4: Third rep: smooth pull down to the upper chest with the same two-second cadence.
beats.5: The bar rises back to full extension, her grip and posture unchanged.
beats.6: Fourth rep: final pull down to the upper chest, elbows down and back, squeeze at the bottom.
beats.7: She controls the bar back up until her arms are fully extended overhead in exactly the same stretched position as the first frame so the clip loops seamlessly.

image.camera: three-quarter front-side camera, full body and the whole machine in frame
image.pose_a: full-body photo of the athlete climbing a commercial stepmill machine — a rotating staircase of four visible steps with side handrails and a small console: frozen mid-stride with her right foot planted on a higher step, left knee driving up toward the next step, hands resting lightly on the rails, body leaning slightly forward with athletic intent
image.pose_b: full-body photo of the athlete on a commercial stepmill machine, frozen at full stride extension: lower leg pressing down powerfully on a step with the knee extending, opposite foot just lifting off the step below, eyes ahead, posture tall, a light sheen of effort

video.camera: locked-off three-quarter front-side camera, full body and the entire rotating staircase always in frame, no cuts, no camera movement
video.summary: 8-second seamless loop: continuous steady climbing on a stepmill at one step per second, eight steps total alternating right and left, the rotating staircase moving smoothly downward beneath her, her body remaining at the same height in frame, ending mid-stride in exactly the phase the clip starts in

beats.0: She steps up with her right foot onto the next rotating step, hands resting lightly on the rails, posture tall.
beats.1: Left foot steps up in rhythm as the staircase rotates smoothly downward beneath her, keeping her at constant height in frame.
beats.2: Right foot up; her breathing is rhythmic, her gaze ahead at the console.
beats.3: Left foot up; steady one-step-per-second cadence, knees driving, heels pressing through each step.
beats.4: Right foot up; slight natural arm and shoulder movement, hands staying in light contact with the rails.
beats.5: Left foot up; the rotating steps continue their constant smooth descent.
beats.6: Right foot up, the same controlled climbing rhythm, body position unchanged in frame.
beats.7: Left foot steps up so she finishes in exactly the same mid-stride phase, body position and step alignment as the first frame so the clip loops seamlessly.
